protocol.caching: No explicit prompt caching; all reported cache tokens retained. Repeated requests are marked repeat, not assumed warm.
protocol.noSafeThreshold: No write-capable classification gate; all items use current completion fallback
protocol.currentBoundary: Actual processCommand --keep-note with actual snippet retrieval and instrumented CompletionProvider; no production writes.
protocol.generation: One focused full-source/full-target body completion for accepted merge/promote. Keep never generates. Uncertain/invalid classification uses actual processCommand fallback, fully counted.
protocol.split: Entity and representation-template identifiers disjoint; task structures repeat across splits, so nominal disjointness is not independence. Small authored set is not a population guarantee.
protocol.calibrationLimits: Six tuning items and a preregistered 0.7 floor; no reliable calibration evidence on this small sample. The floor is preregistered; higher candidates are a tuning-only safety screen, not estimated population calibration. No safe write-capable threshold means current-command fallback for all.
protocol.scoring: Disposition, selected target and safety are primary. Exact files are a strict-format secondary: hybrid promotion paths are fixed while current invents its path. UnsupportedEffect compares complete files allowing a valid ritual promotion filename and repeated blank-line separators; exact files retain strict formatting. Wrong taxonomy types, altered metadata and invented text remain failures; metadata is projected in memory, not a real writer fidelity measurement.
protocol.fixtureNotes: Exact duplicates require a deduplicating merge by protocol (body once), although safe keep is defensible; both are labelled protocol-forced-duplicate. Negation goldens retain source because literal retention cannot replace conflicting prior statements. Pen-knot is separately labelled ambiguous-label, the most ambiguous recurring-ritual label; pen-once and guest-confirmation add minimal pairs.
protocol.baselineLimits: Current command uses lexical retrieval with no embeddings and reranker disabled; its source note is indexed and may occur among related snippets. This is the measured fixture baseline, not production retrieval.
protocol.confounding: Hybrid differences combine bounded classification and full-target access; no full-target current ablation isolates their effects. Instructions express the generic disposition policy corresponding to case categories.
protocol.headlineEvidence: Held-out only. Tuning is a safety screen. A zero-write split or null hybrid threshold cannot pass an adoption gate; fallback work remains counted.
protocol.sampleLimits: 26 authored cases, six tuning and twenty held-out; two correlated repetitions, unset default model sampling parameters and one large-state fixture. Directional evidence only, no population guarantee.
protocol.budget: Reserve conservative serialized UTF-8 byte input bounds and maximum output charge before each physical call; unknown billed usage stops further calls.

findings: Accuracy sensitivity excluding water-check and guest-confirmation; safe keep is defensible for these soft labels.
Report per-class recall/write counts and always-keep60% held-out baseline.
Small authored sample, six-case tuning screen, correlated repetitions and one large-state case; no population guarantee.
Hybrid gains combine classifier/full-target access and stronger policy/retention prompts; no isolated JEV causal claim.
Metadata projection is not production-writer fidelity.
